FAQ_1_Q: Do you see my prompts or API keys?
FAQ_1_A: No. The free tier is fully client-side — the pricing math runs in your browser and the event log lives in localStorage. Only the raw `usage` numbers are needed to compute cost; you can paste them without the prompt body if you're paranoid.
FAQ_2_Q: How do you keep pricing current?
FAQ_2_A: The pricing table is a JSON file shipped with the app, updated monthly against the public pricing pages of each provider. Sourced from the MIT-licensed `tokencost` project plus provider docs. If a price is stale, open an issue on GitHub and we ship a fix same-day.
FAQ_3_Q: Why not just use Langfuse / Helicone / Portkey?
FAQ_3_A: Those are proxies + eval platforms. They see every prompt and completion, they add a network hop, and they start at $50/mo. Agent Cost Tracker is a paste box. If you already run a proxy platform, keep it — this is for the far more common case of 'I just want to know which agent is expensive.'
FAQ_4_Q: Can I automate tracking instead of pasting?
FAQ_4_A: On Pro: yes. `POST /api/v1/events` with a bearer token — one line to add to your agent's response handler. On Free: paste the JSON or upload a CSV of prior calls. Both flows converge to the same dashboard.
